svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Body: 76 mm across, 130 mm from the rim to the start of the cone,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a 30 mm cone below to a 24 mm tip; 3 mm walls and floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 14 mm tube runs up the middle from tip to rim, bore 8 mm for the rope.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Side window 24 mm across, 60 mm below the rim, opposite the glands,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with a 32 mm recess 1.4 mm deep round it for the PTFE membrane.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three screw bosses 12 mm across, 29 mm from the centre at 90, 180 and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 270 degrees, 30 mm deep from the rim, 2.5 mm holes for M3 screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lid: 76 mm across, 10 mm thick, 8 mm centre hole; two 12.2 mm holes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 mm out and 12 mm each side of the centre line for M12 glands;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: three 3.4 mm holes over the bosses. 1 mm EPDM gasket under the lid.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print the body upright, cone down; print the lid flat. ASA, not PLA.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the pod slides on the rope and sits on a rope stop under its tip.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the rope slides through freely; the lid seats flat on the gasket.
